'''Anderton Kloff''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[General/Legends|general]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was the commander of the ground forces on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]].
